_doc: Advertising on blokvolt.rs (docs/RUNBOOK.md 3.26). The media kit page /za-firme/oglasavanje/ and the PDFs are made from this file; ads from the list 'oglasi'. An ad is shown only from 'od' to 'do' (YYYY-MM-DD, both days included), on the pages of its rubric, never on the paths in 'ne_na' and never on a news item (or news list page) whose text contains one of the words in 'ne_uz' (for a network: its brand and company names). Empty 'oglasi' = no ads anywhere. Fields: id, oglasivac, rubrika (vlasnistvo | na-putu | vesti), od, do, url, slika, naslov (≤60), tekst (≤120), alt, ne_na [], ne_uz [], optional 'en'/'ru' {naslov, tekst, alt}. Image: static/assets/oglasi/<slika> (1200x400). Links get utm_source=blokvolt&utm_medium=oglas&utm_campaign=<id>.

posecenost._doc: Filled in once a month from Cloudflare Web Analytics (Pages project blokvolt → Metrics → Web Analytics), whole site, previous calendar month. Empty = the first full month is still being counted.

vlasnistvo.opis: subvencije, registracija i porezi, uvoz i carina, osiguranje, krediti i lizing, servisi, rent-a-car

na-putu.opis: putarina i parking, besplatni punjači, aplikacije i kartice za punjenje, punjenje u regionu
